Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Uses the logged-in character name for room identity and performs a delayed SimpleHeels-style animation refresh only for visible lobby actors after synchronized modded emotes initialize. Purple selections clear at initialization.
